gallery.filename: Line of Soldiers with Bicycles at Fort Keogh, Montana (572deb1019cb4d088cd228923f8d0757).tif
gallery.title: File:Line of Soldiers with Bicycles at Fort Keogh, Montana (572deb1019cb4d088cd228923f8d0757).tif
gallery.artist: Christian Barthelmess (Little Bighorn Battlefield National Monument)
gallery.description:
LIBI_00215_07051; Photo is black and white. It depicts 10 soldiers standing in line. Eight of these hold bicycles. Guns are strapped diagonally across their back. Three building appear in the background.  Image has minor scratches.The verso shows the seal of Chrisitan Barthelmess, photographer, Fort Keogh Montana. There are three different notes in different colored ink. The left-most in red ink reads: "Mc Gee's writing [?], 4th oldest living soldier". Next to this note in blue ink is: “Aug 1896”. The blue “9” has a red “7” super-imposed over it. Below the date is a note in faded black ink that reads: “Fort Keogh Mont.” ; print, photographic; Courtesy of the National Park Service, Little Bighorn Battlefield National Monument, LIBI_00215_07051, Christian Barthelmess, "Line of Soldiers with Bicycles at Fort Kegoh, Montana," circa August 1896.
Keywords: little bighorn battlefield national monument
